name: @lacspace/keypool
description: Provider-agnostic API-key rotation and rate-limit accounting — pool N free keys per provider, track RPM/RPD/TPM/TPD windows from response headers and 429 retry-after, round-robin among healthy keys, cool down on 429, quarantine invalid keys, and keep per-model buckets (Groq TPD is per model). pick(provider, model, estTokens) → key | null; report(key, result). Persist state via a tiny adapter so multiple processes share the pool. Zero-dependency, isomorphic, typed.
author: Lacspace <contact@lacspace.com>
